name: PinnacleCart
description_en:
PinnacleCart is an ecommerce shopping-cart platform with official documentation for product sales, recurring billing and shipping configuration. Accessible operational guides identify the 3.9.x series; some commercial and source-access articles are explicitly archived.

This profile describes those documented workflows and their prerequisites. Current subscription pricing and new-store provisioning were not confirmed because the marketing and plan pages returned HTTP 403.
description_zh:
PinnacleCart 是电商购物车平台，官方文档覆盖商品销售、周期收费及运输配置。可读取的操作指南注明适用于 3.9.x 系列，部分商务及源码访问文章明确已归档。

本稿描述这些有文档依据的流程和前提。营销及套餐页面返回 HTTP 403，当前订阅价格和新店开通未确认。

core_features.explanation_en: The 3.9.x guide describes intervals, trial settings and repeat counts; recurring settings cannot be bulk imported.
core_features.explanation_zh: 3.9.x 指南描述周期、试用设置及重复次数，周期收费设置不能批量导入。

core_features.explanation_en: Shipping setup requires product weights, carrier credentials and a ship-from address for live rates; custom rules can use item count, subtotal or weight.
core_features.explanation_zh: 实时运费需要商品重量、承运商凭据及发货地址；自定义规则可按件数、小计或重量。

sections.title_en: Configure one recurring product with its gateway
sections.title_zh: 结合支付网关配置一件订阅商品
sections.en: The guide starts at Apps → App Center → Recurring Billing, then requires an eligible gateway to be activated in payment settings. Product settings define the trial, interval and repeat count; configuration is per product because recurring settings cannot be bulk imported. The gateway list includes Authorize.Net CIM and Braintree among others, but present-day provider/region eligibility requires confirmation. A trial charge, renewal and cancellation should be tested before taking real customer payments.
sections.zh: 指南从 Apps → App Center → Recurring Billing 开始，随后要求在支付设置中启用合适网关，再逐商品定义试用、收费间隔及重复次数，因为该设置不能批量导入。网关列表包括 Authorize.Net CIM、Braintree 等，但当前服务商及地区资格需确认。收取真实客户款项前应测试试用扣费、续费和取消。

sections.title_en: Test the checkout when no shipping method qualifies
sections.title_zh: 测试没有可用运输方式时的结账
sections.en: The shipping guide uses origin, destination and order weight to calculate carrier rates. Custom methods can depend on item count, order subtotal, total weight or product-specific charges; handling fees are separately configurable. A setting decides whether checkout can finish with no qualifying method. Test an excluded address, missing weight and a free-shipping item with an express alternative, then compare the shown total and tax treatment.
sections.zh: 运输指南按发货地、目的地及订单重量计算承运运费。自定义方式可按件数、小计、总重或商品单独费用，处理费另有设置；另一个选项决定无合适运输方式时是否可完成结账。应测试排除地址、缺失重量及免邮商品加快递选项，并核对总额与税务处理。

sections.title_en: Separate archived charges from current pricing
sections.title_zh: 区分归档收费与当前价格
sections.en: The hosted-resource FAQ describes plan-dependent disk and bandwidth allowances, possible overages and an account billing view. It is under Archive, and the support footer advertises plans from $79.95 per month with an old copyright date. That is historical page content, not a confirmed current offer or overage schedule. The linked current plans page returned 403 and was not retried. Request the applicable subscription, resource limits, gateway fees and implementation terms before purchase.
sections.zh: 托管资源 FAQ 描述按方案提供磁盘与带宽额度、潜在超额费及账户账单查看，但归入 Archive；支持页脚以旧版权日期宣传 $79.95/月起。这是历史页面内容，不能确认为当前优惠或超额费率。链接的现行套餐页返回 403 后未重试。采购前需确认订阅、资源限制、网关费及实施条款。

sections.title_en: Source-code access does not establish open licensing
sections.title_zh: 可访问源码不代表开放许可
sections.en: An archived FAQ says customers can ask their account representative for PHP source-code access. It provides no redistribution license or general right to self-host, so open-source status remains unknown. The recurring-billing guide calls that feature proprietary and says support may need to activate it. Confirm version, entitlements and recovery procedures with the provider. No account, payment, hosting configuration or source-code request was performed.
sections.zh: 归档 FAQ 表示客户可向账户代表申请 PHP 源码，但未提供再分发许可或普遍自托管权利，因此开源状态仍未知。周期收费指南将该功能称为专有功能，并说明可能需支持人员启用。应向服务方确认版本、权限和恢复步骤。未实际登录、付款、配置托管或申请源码。
